E.headline: Frontier LLMs win more than humans in iterated rock-paper-scissors via larger opponent models; the open GPT-OSS-120B does worse than humans.

G.notes: Win-rate comparison with humans is descriptive; human data came from an earlier experiment with its own interface. Temperature 0.5 and default reasoning effort only; no prompt variants. Paradigm status (strategic game versus cognitive experiment) is borderline; the main contribution is behavioural-model discovery.
